say:3:1120637001:1.text: I never thought we would find our father like this after all these years.
say:3:1120637001:1.source_cn: 没想到，我们会以这种方式和父亲重逢。

say:4:1120637002:1.text: He was always traveling the world in search of treasure, and he rarely came home... When he did, he would promise to find enough treasure to give us the best life possible.
say:4:1120637002:1.source_cn: 以前他总是满世界寻宝，很少回家……他总说要找到无人发现...

say:5:1120637003:1.text: The truth is, Oldiler... as much as I wanted to see him again, I was also afraid to know what happened to him.
say:5:1120637003:1.source_cn: 你知道吗，哥哥……一直以来，我既希望能找到他，又害怕知...

say:6:1120637004:1.text: I was scared to find out that he really abandoned us or worse... that he had died somewhere far away.
say:6:1120637004:1.source_cn: 因为我怕他真的抛弃了我们，更怕他……死在外乡。

say:7:1120637005:1.text: I know how you feel, Evan... But we found him all the same.
say:7:1120637005:1.source_cn: 我明白你的感受……但，我们找到他了。

say:8:1120637006:1.text: Come on, let's find some stuff to make a proper grave for him.
say:8:1120637006:1.source_cn: 来吧，我们找些材料，立好墓碑。

say:9:1120637007:1.text: Compared to our hometown, I'm sure he liked this place a lot more. After all, it's where you can see Esperia's most beautiful sunsets.
say:9:1120637007:1.source_cn: 相比于家乡，我觉得父亲更喜欢这里——这里有伊索米亚最壮...

say:10:1120637008:1.text: And he said this was one of the greatest treasures to be discovered.
say:10:1120637008:1.source_cn: 他说了，这是他人生旅途上的宝藏。
